subject: Cannot access my account — locked out
description: I have been locked out of my account after several failed login attempts. I tried resetting my password but the reset email never arrived. Please help me regain access.

subject: Application crashes immediately on startup
description: Every time I open the desktop application it crashes within two seconds and shows an error in the console. I have reinstalled it twice but the problem persists.

subject: Invoice shows incorrect charge amount
description: My latest invoice shows a charge of $149 but my plan is $99 per month. I have never upgraded and did not authorize this extra charge. Please review and issue a refund.

subject: Request: add dark mode to the web app
description: I work late evenings and the bright interface strains my eyes. Would it be possible to add a dark mode toggle? Many of my colleagues have made the same suggestion.

subject: Checkout fails with payment error on last step
description: Defect found in checkout flow. Steps to reproduce: add item to cart, proceed to payment, enter card details, click Pay. Expected behavior: order completes. Actual behavior: error message 'Payment failed' appears and order is not placed.

subject: Two-factor authentication codes not arriving
description: I enabled 2FA on my account but the SMS codes stopped arriving three days ago. I cannot sign in without the code. I have verified my phone number is correct.

subject: Dashboard takes over 30 seconds to load
description: Since the last update the main dashboard is extremely slow. It takes between 30 and 60 seconds before data appears. All other pages load normally. I have tested on two different networks.

subject: Charged twice for the same subscription
description: I was billed twice on the same day for my monthly subscription. My bank statement shows two identical charges of $49.99 on the 1st of this month. Please refund the duplicate payment.

subject: Add CSV export for reports
description: It would be very helpful to export monthly reports as CSV files for use in Excel. Currently only PDF export is available which is not useful for our data analysis workflows.

subject: Search returns no results for valid queries
description: Defect: search bar returns zero results for terms that definitely exist. Steps to reproduce: navigate to search, type a known product name, press enter. Expected: matching results. Actual: 'No results found' message. Regression introduced in last week's release.

subject: General feedback on the new UI design
description: Just wanted to share some thoughts on the recent redesign. Overall it looks great but the new navigation bar is a bit confusing at first. A short walkthrough tooltip would help new users.

subject: Critical: production API is down for all users
description: Production is down. The API is returning 503 errors for all endpoints since 09:15 UTC. This is a critical outage affecting all of our customers. We need immediate assistance.

subject: What is included in the Pro plan?
description: I am considering upgrading but cannot find a clear comparison between the Basic and Pro plans on the pricing page. Could you send me a breakdown of what features and usage limits are included?

subject: Request native mobile app for iOS and Android
description: The mobile website works but a native app would improve the experience significantly. Many of our team use mobile devices exclusively. Would love push notifications and offline access.

subject: User settings are not saved after page refresh
description: Defect: custom notification settings reset to defaults on every page reload. Steps to reproduce: go to Settings > Notifications, change preferences, refresh page. Expected: settings persist. Actual: all settings revert to defaults.

subject: Forgot my username — cannot find it anywhere
description: I set up my account over a year ago and cannot remember my username. The login page only accepts usernames, not email addresses. Is there a way to recover or look up my username?

subject: Webhook integration throwing timeout errors
description: Our webhook integration has been failing with timeout errors for the past 48 hours. The endpoint is healthy and responding within 200ms. The errors appear to be on your side.

subject: How do I cancel my subscription?
description: I would like to cancel my subscription at the end of the current billing period. I could not find a cancel option in my account settings. Please guide me through the cancellation process.

subject: Request: bulk delete for old records
description: We accumulate thousands of old records monthly and deleting them one by one is not feasible. A bulk-select and delete feature would save our operations team hours of work every month.

subject: Request to permanently delete my account and data
description: I would like to request deletion of my account and all associated personal data under GDPR. Please confirm the process and expected timeline for data removal.
